_note: Anima Aesthetic, from ComfyUI's template image_anima_base_v1 (its CLIPLoader type, euler, simple, 30 steps, CFG 4, EmptyLatentImage) with CircleStone Labs' Aesthetic checkpoint in place of Base. The negative is empty, as on mflux, where the card's (without its score_* tags, as it says for Aesthetic) changed almost nothing. With the Limits off, the prompt starts with Anima's safety tags (server/images/modelPrompt.ts). $names are filled in by server/images/comfyui/workflow.ts. The picture comes back over the WebSocket (SaveImageWebsocket), so ComfyUI writes no file. Attention is Comfy Kitchen's int8 (ModelAttentionBackend), as Ming-Image's template has it: less time sampling on an NVIDIA card (docs/research/image-models.md), PyTorch's attention where it can't run, as on a Mac.
